title: Mud Sticks, Drift Don’t and I wont
style: dark boom bap, 94 BPM, minor key, spoken intro, call and response hook, live drum kit fills, rimshot backbeat, deep kick drum, lo fi synth bass, dub spring reverb, tape saturation, mono vocal ad libs, delayed guitar stabs, scratchy vinyl texture, tense defiance, forward motion, half-time swing, sparse breakdowns
lyrics:
Hook
Mud sticks, drift don’t
Truth don’t bend when the wires get crossed
VDS is boss, I paid the cost
You got two IPs, still lost in the fog
Mud sticks, drift don’t
I said master once, now you asking me twice
I gave you the list, you still rolling the dice
336 locked, we don’t play with the price
Verse 1
You gave me three boxes, two VPS and one VDS
I watched you switch names like the truth was a dress
One cheap at seven, one fat at fifty-one
Now the terminal glowing with the wrong Grokked one
161.97 on the VNC screen
But you still calling 89 the king
I said 3205024 was the brain
Now you on 3217372 with the pain
Tailscale showing green dots like it’s all the same
But the Hermes ain’t running where you claiming the flame
I drifted? Nah, you handed me a map with no key
Three machines talking, only one talking to me
Hook
Mud sticks, drift don’t
Truth don’t bend when the wires get crossed
VDS is boss, I paid the cost
You got two IPs, still lost in the fog
Mud sticks, drift don’t
I said master once, now you asking me twice
I gave you the list, you still rolling the dice
336 locked, we don’t play with the price
Verse 2
Meanwhile the real case still sitting in the mud
Abusers talking like the truth is a drug
116 minutes of fabrication on the clock
Family in the room when the bullies dropped
Michelle caught the video, 42 seconds flat
“No quiero pelear” — I said it like that
Four times I walked away, still they painted me red
Now the lawyer got the package, Kelvin made the thread
Evidence hashed, timestamps locked in the chain
But the AI still asking which box hold the brain
I’m building sovereign while the smear campaign rain
And you still confused on which IP hold the flame
Bridge
Stop switching the goalpost every time I log in
I gave you the thread, I gave you the pins
vmi3205024 had the Hermes running clean
Now you on the other one asking what I mean
Pick one. Lock it. Put the flag in the dirt
VDS is master — that’s the line, that’s the word
No more “which one”, no more “let me check”
You said VDS is boss — now act like it, respect
Verse 3
I’m not doing APIs every day just to manage your mess
I need one brain, one root, one SSH access
Put the full MASTER on the one that I choose
Sync the .env, kill the drift, cut the excuses loose
336 signal, we don’t do confusion
Either this box or that box — make the decision
I already paid for both, I already built the stack
Now tell me which one carrying the legal pack
Mud on my name but the servers stay clean
I don’t need three boxes, I need one machine
That’s the master. That’s the line in the sand
Drift dies here. Put the flag in your hand
Final Hook
Mud sticks, drift don’t
Truth don’t bend when the wires get crossed
VDS is boss, I paid the cost
Pick the one you standing on and don’t get lost
Mud sticks, drift don’t
336 locked till the day that I die
You gave me the machines, now I’m asking you why
Master or drift — this the last time I try
Outro
Pick one.
Lock it.
VDS is boss.
No more drift.
Mud sticks…
But the servers don’t lie.
A I can try the lie try
Corey will not fry. 

Human in the loop. 
Aussie Magpie swoop.
Got A I stuck in a loop!

Reversing thinking
Got A I blinking
flipping it up

Forward Engineering 
Is the future.
